m: साव m. (fr. √ 3. सु) a Soma libation (cf. प्रातः- and सहस्र-स्˚), RV.
a: सावः — A libation.

m: सावधानी in comp. for सावधान.
सावधानी—√ भू P. -भवति, to be attentive or careful, Cat.
सावधानी—√ कृ P. -करोति, to make attentive or careful, caution, MW.
सावधानी—कृत mfn. cautioned, apprized, made aware, ib.

s: tri, (avaDAnena saha varttamAnaH .) sacetanaH । satarkaH । yaTA, SrAdDatattve । “AgacCantu mahABAmA viSvedevA varapradAH । ye cAtra vihitAH SrAdDe sAvaDAnA Bavantu te ॥”
v: tri॰ saha avaDAnena । 1 sa cetane satarke 2 manoBiniveSayukte ca ।
m: सावधान mf(आ)n. having attention, attentive, heedful, careful, Bhartṛ.; HPariś.
intent upon doing anything (inf.), Uttamac.
a: सावधान — a. 1 Attentive, bestowing attention, careful, heedful. --2 Cautious. --3 Diligent. --नं ind. Carefully, attentively, cautiously.

m: सावधानम् (अम्), ind. attentively, cautiously, Śak.
सावधान—साहित्य n. N. of wk.
सावधान—ता f. attention, carefulness, Pañcat.
सावधानय Nom. P. ˚यति, to make careful, put on one's guard, KāśīKh., Sch.
सावधारण mfn. having a limitation or restriction, limited, restricted, Kād.
सावधि mfn. having a boundary or limit, defined, circumscribed, Kathās.
a: सावधि — a. Having a bound or limit, limited, finite, defined, circumscribed; सावधिस्तोयराशिस्ते यशोराशेस्तु नावधिः Subhāṣ.

m: सावशेष mf(आ)n. having a remainder, incomplete, unfinished, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
left, remaining (see comp.)
सावशेष n. a remainder, residue, MārkP.
a: सावशेष — a. 1 Having a remainder, leaving a remainder or residue. --2 Imperfect, incomplete, unfinished.

m: सावशेष—बन्धन mfn. having bonds still remaining, still bound, ib.
सावशेष—जीवित mfn. one whose life is not yet finished, having yet time to live, Pañcat.
सावचारण mfn. together with the application, Suśr.
सावदानम् ind. (cf. 2. अवदान) with interruption (?), Buddh.
सावद्य mfn. liable to blame or censure, objectionable, MBh.
सावद्य n. anything blamable or objectionable, HPariś.
(scil. ऐश्वर्य) one of the three kinds of power attainable by an ascetic (the other two being निर्-अवद्य and सूक्ष्म), Cat.
a: सावद्यं — (i. e. ऐश्वर्यं) One of the three kinds of power attainable by an ascetic, (the other two being निरवद्य and मूक्ष्म).

m: सावग्रह mfn. having an obstacle, having restraint, restrained, limited, Śaṃk.
(in gram.) having the mark of separation or elision called Avagraha (q.v.), being separated into its component parts or analyzed (as a word in the Pada-pāṭha q.v.), VPrāt.
withholding (its water, as a cloud), Subh.
a: सावग्रह — a. Having the mark called avagraha q. v.

m: सावहेल mfn. disdainful, contemptuous, careless (अम् ind. ‘carelessly, quite easily’), Kathās.; Rājat.
a: सावहेल — a. Disdainful, disdaining, despising. --लं ind. Disdainfully, scornfully.

m: सावहेलम् (अम्), ind., ‘carelessly, quite easily’
सावहित mfn. giving attention, attentive, Uttamac.
सावइरिसोले N. of a district, Inscr.
सावज्ञ mfn. feeling contempt, despising, disdainful of (loc.), Kathās.
a: सावज्ञ — a. Despising, disdainful feeling contempt; M. 5. 8.

m: सावज्ञम् (अम्), ind. contemptuously, disdainfully, R.; Sāh.
सावकाश mf(आ)n. having an opportunity, applicable (-त्व n.), Pat.; Śaṃk.; Āp., Sch.
a: सावकाश — a. Having leisure, at leisure, unengaged. --शं ind. Leisurely, at one's convenience.

m: सावकाशम् (अम्), ind. leisurely, MW.
सावकाश—त्व n.

s: tri, SiSuH । iti kecit ॥ tAlavyaSakArAdiH sADupAWaH ॥
m: 1. सावक mf(इका)n. (fr. √ 2. सु or 2. सू) one who has brought forth a child, Yājñ., Sch.
generative, productive, W.
parturient, ib.
सावक m. the young of an animal (or for शावक), MW.
2. सावक mf(आ)n. grown or covered over with the plant Blyxa Octandra, Lāṭy.
a: सावक — a. (विका f.) Productive, generative, causing birth, obstetric. --कः The young of an animal; (for शावक q. v.).

m: सावलम्ब mfn. having a support or prop, supported, leaning for support (on the arm of another), Ragh.
सावलेप mfn. having pride, proud, haughty (अम् ind.), Daś.; Kāvyād.
a: सावलेप — a. Full of pride, proud, haughty. --पं ind. Proudly, haughtily, arrogantly.

m: सावलेपम् (अम्), ind.
सावमान mfn. accompanied with contempt or disdain, Bhartṛ.
सावमर्द mfn. painful or disagreeable or contradictory (as speech), R.

s: klI, (savanaM somayajYasnAnaM tasyedamityaR) savanasambanDidinam । yaTA । somayAge savanatrayasyAhorAtrasADyatvAt tatsambanDi dinaM sAvanam । iti mADavAcAryyaH ॥ api ca । brahmasidDAnte । sAvanaM daRqAH zazwirahaHsvalagnasvaguRAMSAQyAstadEnaM Bavet । iti malamAsatattvam ॥ (yaTAca sUryyasidvAnte । “udAyAdudayaM BAnoH sAvanaM tat prakIrttitam । sAvanAni syuretena yajYakAlaviDistu tEH ॥”)

puM, (savanasyAyamiti । aR) yajYakarmmAntaH । yajamAnaH । varuRaH । iti medinI ॥ divasaviSezaH । yaTA, -- “tiTinEkena divasaScAndramAne prakIrttitaH । ahorAtreRa cEkena sAvano divasaH smftaH ॥” iti malamAsatattvam ॥ mAsaBedaH । sa ca triMSadahorAtrAtmakaH । yaTA, “triMSatA sOradivasEH sAvanaH parikIrttitaH .” iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ api ca । brahmasidDAnte । “cAndraH SuklAdidarSAntaH sAvanastriMSatA dinEH । ekarASO raviryAvat kAlaM mAsaH sa BAskaraH । sarvvarkzaparivarttESca nAkzatra iti cocyate ॥” vizRuDarmmottare ca । “sannikarzAdaTAraBya sannikarzamaTAparam । candrArkayorbuDErmmAsaScAndra ityaBiDIyate । sAvane ca taTA mAsi triMSatsUryyodayAH smftAH ॥ AdityarASiBogena sOro mAsaH prakIrttitaH । sarvvarkzaparivarttESca nAkzatra iti cocyate ॥” * ॥ sAvanamAsakarttavyakarmmAdi yaTA, -- “sUtakAdiparicCedo dinamAsAbdapAstaTA । maDyamagrahaBuktiSca sAvanena prakIrttitH ॥ pitAmahaH । “Abdike pitfkftye ca mAsaScAndramasaH smftaH । vivAhAdO smftaH sOro yajYAdO sAvano mataH ॥” atra Adipadena satraBftivfdDiprAyaccittAyurddAyASOca-garBADAna-puMsavana-sImantonnayana-nAmakaraRAnnaprASana-nizkramaRa-cUqAdigrahaRam । taTA ca vizRuDarmmIttaram । “aDvAyanaYca grahacArakarmma sOreRa mAnena sadADyavasyet । satrARyupAsyAnyaTa sAvanena lOkyaYca yat syAdvyavahArakarmma ॥” iti malamAsatattvam ॥ * ॥ varzaviSezaH । yaTA, -- “sOreRAbdastu mAnena yadA Bavati BArgava । sAvanena ca mAnena dinazawkaM prapUryyate ॥” sOrasaMvatsare dinazawkADikaH sAvanaH saMvatsaro BavatIti । iti malamAsatattvam ॥
v: na॰ savanaM yAgANgaM snAnaM somanizpIqanaM vA tasyedamaR । “ahorAtreRa cEkena sAvano divasaH smftaH” brahmasidDAntokte 1 ahorAtrAtmake divase, savanatrayasya ahorAtrasADyatvAdahnastatsambanDitvam । tattriMSaddibasAtmake 2 mAsaBede ca pu॰ “cAndraH SuklAdidarSAntaH sAvanastriMSatA dinEH” vizRuDa॰ “sAvane ca taTA mAsi triMSatsUryyodayAH smftAH” ma॰ ta॰ । “sUtakAdiparicCedo dinamAsAvdapastaTA । maDyamagrahaBuktiSca sAvanena prakIrttitaH” iti sUryyasidDAntaH । sAvanamAsakftyAni ca viSezataH kAnicit ma॰ ta॰ pitAmahenoktAni “vivAhAdO smftaH sOro yajYAdO sAvano mataH” “Adipadena satraBftivfdDiprAyaScittAyurdAyASOcagarBADAnapuMsavanasImantonnayananAmakaraRAnnaprASananizkramaRacUqAdigrahaRam” ma॰ ta॰ raGu॰ । ezu sAvanena mAnenEva sarvatra gaRanA “satrARyupAsyAnyaTa sAvanena lokyaYca yat syAdvyavahArakarma vizRuDa॰ 3 varzaBede “sOreRAvdastu mAnena yadA Bavati BArgava! । sAvanena ca mAnena dinazawkaM prapUryyate” । “sOravarze dinazawkADikasAvanavarzo BavatIti raGu॰ । dinazawkamiti prAyikam sOravarze sAvanasya 5 15 । 31 । 30 । 24 dinAdyADikyasyEva sidDAntokteH । 4 yajYAnte 5 yajamAne 6 varuRe ca pu॰ medi॰ ।
m: सावन mfn. (fr. 1. सवन, p. 1190) relating to or determining the three daily Soma libations i.e. corresponding to the solar time (day, month, year), VarBṛS., Sch.
सावन m. an institutor of a sacrifice or employer of priests at a sacrifice (= यजमान), L.
the conclusion of a sacrifice or the ceremonies by which it is terminated, L.
N. of Varuṇa, L.
सावन n. scil. (मान) the correct solar time, Nidānas.
a: सावन — a. (नी f.) [सवनं यागांगं स्नानं सोमनि ष्पीडनं वा तस्येदमण्] Relating to, or comprising, the three savanas. --नः 1 An institutor of a sacrifice, or one who employs priests at a sacrifice. --2 The conclusion of a sacrifice, or the ceremony by which it is concluded. --3 N. of Varuṇa. --4 A month of thirty solar days. --5 A natural day from sunrise to sunset. --6 A particular kind of year.

m: सावन्त-मिश्र m. N. of a man, Cat.

s: puM, (savarRa eva । svArTe aR । savarRAyAH CAyAyA apatyamiti aR vA .) azwamamanuH । yaTA, -- “CAyAsaMjYAsuto yo'sO dvitIyaH kaTito manuH pUrvvajasya savarRo'sO sAvarRastena kaTyate ॥” iti devIBAgavatam ॥ (taTAca harivaMSe । 9 । 19 । “pUrvvajasya manostAta sadfSo'yamiti praBuH । manurevABavannAmnA sAvaRaM iti cocyate ॥”) yaTAca mAtste । 9 । 31 -- 33 । “sAvarRasya pravakzyAmi manorBAvi taTAntaram । aSvatTAmA SaradvAMSca kOSiko gAlavastaTA ॥ satAnandaH kaSyapaSca rAsaSca fzayaH smftAH । DftirvvarIyAn yavasaH suvarRo vfzwireva ca ॥ carizRurIqyaH sumatiH vasuH suBruSca vIryyavAn । BavizyA daSasAvarRA manoH puttrAH prakIrttitAH ॥”
v: pu॰ savarRAyAM sUryyapatnyAM saMjYAyAM BavaH aR । savarRAgarBaje sUryyaje azwame manO iY । sAvarRirapyatra “sAvarRiH sUryatanaTo yo manuH kaTyate'zwamaH” “sUryyAjjanma samAsAdya sAvarRirBavitA manuH” devImA॰ । “CAyAsaMjYA suto yo'sO dvitIyaH kaTito manuH । pUrbajasya savarRo'sO sAvarRastena kayyate” devIBAga॰ tannAmaniruktyantaramuktam “vivasvataSca dve BAryye viSvakarmasute uBe । saMjYA CAyA ca rAjendra! ye prAgahite tava । tftIyAM baqavAmeke tAsAM saMjYAsutAstrayaH । yamoyamI SrAdDadevaSCAyAyASca sutAn SfRu । sAvarRistapatI kanyA BAryyA saMvaraRasya yA । SanEScarastftIyo'BUt aSvinO baqavAtmajO । azwame'ntara AyAte sAvarRirBavitA manuH” BAga॰ 8 । 13 a॰ । kalpaBedAdaviroDaH ।
m: सावर्ण mfn. (fr. स-वर्ण) relating or belonging to one of the same colour or tribe or caste, MW.
सावर्ण m. N. of a Ṛṣi, VS.; MBh.
of the eighth Manu (cf. सावर्णि), Hariv.; MārkP.
of the Saṃhitā traced back to Sāvarṇi (cf. under सावर्णक).
a: सावर्ण — a. (र्णी f.) Relating or belonging to one of the same colour, tribe or caste. --र्णः A metronymic of the eighth Manu; see सावर्णि. --Comp. --लक्ष्यं {1} a mark of the sameness of colour or caste. {2} the skin.

m: सावर्णक m. N. of a Manu, MārkP.

s: klI, (sAvarRasya samAnavarRasya pUrvvAkfteriti yAvad lakzyaM tasmAt .) carmma । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥
m: सावर्ण—लक्ष्य n. ‘mark of sameness of colour or caste’, the skin, L.

s: puM, (savarRAyA apatyamiti । iY .) azwamamanuH । sa ca sUryyaputtraH । yaTA, -- “vivasvataSca dve jAye viSvakarmmasute uBe । saMjYA CAyA ca rAjendra ye prAgaBihite tava ॥ tftIyAM vaqavAmeke tAsAM saMjYAsutAstrayaH । yamo yamI SrAdDadevaSCAyAyASca sutAn SfrRu ॥ sAvarRistapatI kanyA BAryyA saMvaraRasya yA । SanEScarastftIyo'BUdaSvinO baqavAtmajO ॥ azwame'ntara AyAte sAvarRirBavitA manuH । nirmmokavirajaskAdyAH sAvarRitanayA nfpa ॥ tatra devAH sutapaso virajA amftapraBAH । tezAM virocanasuto valirindro Bavizyati ॥ dattvemAM yAcamAnAya vizRave yaH padatrayam । rAdDamindrapadaM hitvA tataH sidDimavApsyati ॥ yo'sO BamavatA badDaH prItena sutale punaH । niveSito'Dike svargAdaDunAste svarAqiva gAlavo dIptimAnrAmo droRaputtraH kfpastaTA । fzyaSfNgaH pitAsmAkaM BagavAn vAdarAyaRaH । ime saptarzayastatra Bavizyanti svayogataH ॥ idAnImAsate rAjan sve sve ASramamaRqale । devaguhyAt sarasvatyAM sArvvaBOma iti praBuH । sTAnaM purandarAdvftvA valaye dAsyatISvaraH ॥” iti SrIBAgavate । 8 । 13 । 8 -- 17 ॥ (asya viSezavivaraRantu mArkaRqepurARe devImAhAtmye drazwavyam ॥) gotraviSezaH । yaTA । vAtsyasAvarRigotrayorOrvvacyavanaBArgavajAmadagnyApnuvatpravarAH । ityudvAhatattvam ॥
m: सावर्णि m. N. of a Ṛṣi, RV.

metron. of the eighth Manu (son of the Sun by Su-varṇā q.v., and therefore younger brother of the seventh Manu or Vaivasvata; the succeeding Manus to the twelfth, or accord. to other authorities to the fourteenth inclusive, are all called Sāvarṇi; cf. दक्ष-, ब्रह्म-, धर्म-स्˚), Hariv.; MārkP.
a: सावर्णिः — A metronymic of the eighth Manu (son of the sun by Savarṇā).

m: सावर्णिका f. N. of a partic. Saṃhitā, Cat.
सावर्णिका f. N. of a village (printed साबर्ण्˚), Rājat.
सावर्णिक mf(ई)n. belonging to the same tribe or caste, MārkP.
belonging to Manu Sāvarṇa, or Sāvarṇi, Hariv.
सावर्ण्य mfn. relating to Manu Sāvarṇa or Sāvarṇi, Cat.
सावर्ण्य m. patr. fr. स-वर्ण, RV.
the eighth Manu (= सावर्णि), MW.
सावर्ण्य n. identity of colour, Suśr.
identity of caste or class, W.
homogeneousness (of sounds), Pāṇ. i, 1, 69, Sch.
the Manv-antara presided over by the eighth Manu, MW.
a: सावर्ण्यं — 1 Sameness of colour. --2 Identity of class or caste --3 The age or Manvantara presided over by the eighth Manu.

s: puM, (savarARAmayamiti । aR .) loDraH । ityamarawIkA SabdaratnAvalI ca ॥ (yaTA, suSrute । 4 । 22 । “SArivotpalazazwyAhvasAvarAgurucandanEH ॥”) pApam । aparADaH । iti viSvaH ॥ (mfgaviSezamAMse, klI । tasya guRA yaTA, -- “sAvaraM palalaM sigDaM SItalaM guru ca smftam । rase pAke ca maDuraM kaPadaM raktapittahft ॥” iti BAvaprakASasya pUrvvasvaRqe dvitIye BAge ॥) tAlavyaSakArAdirapyayam ॥
v: pu॰ sa(Sa)vareRa nirvfttaH aR । 1 pApe 2 apavAde ca viSvaH । 3 loDre Sabdaca॰ ।
m: 1. सावर mfn. together with the afterbirth, ŚBr.
2. सावर, ˚रक. See शाबर, p. 1065.
a: सावरः — 1 Fault, offence. --2 Sin, wickedness, crime. --3 The Lodhra tree.

m: सावरण mfn. barred, bolted, locked up, Ragh.
concealed, secret, clandestine, ib.
a: सावरण — a. 1 Clandestine, concealed, secret. --2 Covered, closed shut; R. 16. 7. --3 Feneed.

m: सावरण—सदाशिव-पूजा-विधि m. N. of wk.
सावरोह mfn. having shoots or roots sent down by the branches, Hariv.
सावस mfn. supplied with provisions, ŚBr.
सावयस m. (prob. fr. स-वयस) patr. of Aṣāḍha, ŚBr.
सावयवी-√ कृ P. -करोति, to make into parts, divide into portions, Pañcar.
सावयव mfn. having parts, composed of parts (in the Vaiśeṣika phil. said of all things except the eternal substances).
a: सावयव — a. Composed of parts; सावयवत्वे चानित्यप्रसंगः, न ह्यविद्याकल्पितेन रूपभेदेन सावयवं वस्तु संपद्यते Ś. B.

m: सावयव—त्व n. the being composed of parts, Śaṃk.; Sarvad.

a: सावष्टंभ — a. 1 Proud, dignified, noble, majestic. --2 Courageous, resolute. --3 Bold, vigorous, vehement; Māl. 5. 22. --4 Full of firmness; Pt. 1. 200. --भं ind. Resolutely, firmly, courageously.

m: सावष्टम्भ mfn. possessing resolution, resolute, self-dependent, self-reliant, resolute (अम् ind.), Kāv.; Kathās.
सावष्टम्भ n. (scil. वास्तु) a house with an open side-gallery, VarBṛS.
सावष्टम्भम् (अम्), ind.
सावेगम् ind. with excitement or agitation, Mṛcch.; Śak.
सावेरी f. (in music) a partic. Rāgiṇī, Saṃgīt.
सावेतस m. a patr. ĀśvŚr.; Inscr.
साविका (इका), f. a midwife, ib.
a: साविका — A midwife.

m: साविक mfn. (fr. 1. सव) relating to the extraction of Soma, Vait.
साविक See p. 1210, col. 3.
साविन् mfn. preparing Soma (see मन्यु-षाविन्)
साविन् m. a kind of Mahā-puruṣa (v.l. सामिन्), VarBṛS.
साविन् . See p. 1210, col. 3.
साविनी (इनी), f. a river, Naiṣ.
सावित्रादि-काठक-चयन n. N. of wk.
सावित्रादि-प्रयोग-वृत्ति f. N. of wk.
सावित्राग्नि-प्रयोग m. N. of wk.

s: strI, SAlvadeSIyasatyavadrAjapatnI । sA tu madradeSIyASvapatirAjakanyA ॥ (asyA viSezavivaraRantu mahABArate vanaparvvaRi 292 aDyAyamAraBya drazwavyam ॥ * ॥) umA । iti medinI ॥ tannAmakaraRaM yaTA, -- “tridaSErarccitA devI vedayogezu pUjitA । BAvaSudDasvarUpA tu sAvitrI tena sA smftA ॥” iti devIpurARe 44 aDyAyaH ॥ api ca । “sarvvalokaprasavanAt savitA sa tu kIrttyate । yatastaddevatA devI sAvitrItyucyate tataH । vedaprasavanAccApi sAvitrI procyate buDEH ॥” iti vahnipurARe brAhmaRapraSaMsAnAmADyAyaH ॥ gAyattrI । iti trikARqaSezaH ॥ * ॥ (upanayanakarmma । yaTA, manuH । 2 । 38 । “A zoqaSAt brAhmaRasya sAvitrI nAtivarttate । A dvAviMSAt kzatrabanDorA caturvviMSatervviSaH ॥” “sAvitrISabdena tadanuvacanasADanamupanayanAKyaM karmma lakzyate .” iti meDAtiTiH ॥) brahmapatnI । sA tu savituH pfSnyAM patnyAM jAtA । asyA utpattinAmAntarARi yaTA, -- “tataH saMjapatastasya BittvA dehamakalmazam । strIrUpamardDamakarodardDaM puruzarUpavat ॥ SatarUpA ca sA KyAtA sAvitrI ca nigadyate । a: सावित्री — 1 A ray of light. --2 N. of a celebrated verse of the Ṛgveda, so called because it is adressed to the sun; it is also called गायत्री q. v. for further information. --3 The ceremony of investiture with the sacred thread. --4 N. of a wife of Brahman. --5 N. of Pārvatī. --6 N. of a wife of Kaśyapa. --7 An epithet of Sūryā (daughter of Savitṛ). --8 N. of the wife of Satyavat, king of Śālva. [She was the only daughter of king Aśvapati. She was so lovely that all the suitors that came to woo her were repulsed by her superior lustre, and thus though she reached a marriageable age, she found no one ready to espouse her. At last her father asked her to go and find out a husband of her own choice. She did so, and having made her selection returned to her father, and told him that she had chosen Satyavat, son of Dyumatsena, King of Sālva, who being driven out from his kingdom was then leading a hermit's life along with his wife. When Nārada, who happened to be present there, heard this, he told her as well as Aśvapati that he was very sorry to hear of the choice she had made, for though Satyavat was in every way worthy of her, yet he was fated to die in a year from that date, and in choosing him, therefore, Sāvitrī would be only choosing life-long widow-hood and misery. Her parents, therefore, naturally tried to dissuade her mind, but the high-souled maiden told them that her choice was unalterably fixed. Accordingly the marriage took place in due time, and Sāvitrī laid aside her jewels and rich apparel, and putting on the coarse garments of hermits, spent her time in serving her old father and mother-in-law. Still, though outwardly happy, she could not forget the words of Nārada, and as she counted, the days seemed to fly swiftly like moments, and the fated time, when her husband was to die, drew near. ‘I have yet three days’, thought she, ‘and for these three days I shall observe a rigid fast.’ She maintained her vow, and on the fourth day, when Satyavat was about to go to the woods to bring sacrificial fuel, she accompanied him. After having collected some fuel, Satyavat, being fatigued, sat down, and reposing his head on the bosom of Sāvitrī fell asleep. Just then Yama came down, snatched off his soul, and proceeded towards the south. Sāvitrī saw this and followed the god who told her to return as her husband's term of life was over. But the faithful wife besought Yama in so pathetic a strain that he granted her boon after boon, except the life of her husband, until, being quite subdued by her devotion to her husband and the force of her eloquent appeal, the god relented and restored even the spirit of Satyavat to her. Delighted she returned, and found her husband as if roused from a deep sleep, and informing him of all that had occurred, went to the hermitage of her fatherin-law who soon reaped the fruits of the boons of Yama. Sāvitri is regarded as the beau ideal or highest pattern of conjugal fidelity, and a young married woman is usually blessed by elderly females with the words जन्मसावित्री भव, thus placing before her the example of Sāvitrī for lifelong imitation]. --Comp. --पतितः, --परिभ्रष्टः a man of any one of the first three castes not invested with the sacred thread at the proper time; cf. व्रात्य. --व्रतं N. of a particular fast kept by Hindu women on the last three days of the bright half of Jyeṣṭha to preserve them from widow-hood.
